newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Five arrested for Argentine photographer murder.
newsitem.headline: Five arrested for Argentine photographer murder.

text.p: Argentine police arrested five suspects on Tuesday in the murder of magazine photographer Jose Luis Cabezas, police spokesmen said.

Police also seized three pistols of the same calibre as the one that was used to kill Cabezas before his handcuffed body was incinerated in his car at the beach resort of Pinamar on Jan. 18, police spokesmen told local news agencies.
Buenos Aires province Security Secretary Eduardo de Lazzari hailed the arrests as "an important step forward in the investigations."

Cabezas, a 35-year-old father of three, worked for the sometimes controversial news magazine Noticias and was covering the vacation season at Pinamar, which is popular with the rich and powerful, when he was killed.
His murder caused protests by journalists and local and international press organisations, who claimed he was killed by people angered by the magazine's reporting.
